title: The Msasa Tree — Zimbabwe (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona heritage nature seasons Zimbabwe Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The msasa tree turns red before the rains in Zimbabwe
A signal understood by every creature and every day
That the dry season's ending and the wet is on its way
The msasa tree is the first thing that knows what the clouds will say

[Chorus]
The msasa tree, the msasa tree
Turning red on the kopjes before the rain is free
The msasa tree, the msasa tree
It knows the sky's intention before the clouds can see
The msasa knows October like no calendar could say
The msasa tree is burning red — the rains are on their way

[Verse 2]
The children knew the msasa and could name the turning seasons
Not from a book but from living in the country and its reasons
The school was the farm and the farm was the education
The msasa tree was the first chapter of the nation

[Bridge]
Now I see trees in Perth — the peppercorn and jacaranda
And they tell their own seasons with a different kind of grammar
But somewhere in the chest there's still the msasa burning
And October here still brings that old familiar yearning

[Outro]
Msasa knows October… always did… always will…
The gardens still growing
